eyebrow: Work through an unknown number of arguments
code:
$ ./restart-all.sh web-01 web-02 db-01

while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  echo "Restarting $1..."
  shift
done

Restarting web-01...
Restarting web-02...
Restarting db-01...
caption: shift drops $1 and renumbers the rest down by one each pass

code:
$ read -p "Server name to restart: " server_name
Server name to restart: web-01

$ read -s -p "Enter the deploy token: " token
Enter the deploy token:
caption: read -p prompts on one line; -s hides what's typed, for tokens/passwords

subtitle: Making a script fail loudly and safely instead of quietly doing the wrong thing.
